matter.question: Which source-supported jurisdiction pathway could legitimately support a first future SGL-001 clinic-development relationship?
matter.title: Legitimate first clinic pathway
matter.why_it_matters: A future clinic pathway must be lawful and evidence-supported; low enforcement cannot substitute for legality.

program.current_formulation_hypothesis: Intranasal mesenchymal-stromal-cell-derived small-EV preparation with defined identity, purity, dose, and a mechanism-relevant potency assay; therapeutic cargo remains to be selected.
program.largest_unresolved_risk: Intranasal CNS exposure observed in rodents may not translate to larger species or humans.
program.name: SGL-001 development program
program.next_proposed_action: Implement Stage 1 with timebound subprojects: source-cell/MCB-WCB (timeline + owner), orthogonal QC panel + draft release specs, fit-for-purpose validation of potency/stability assays, three representative GMP-like scale-up runs with release/stability assessment, and formulation/device compatibility testing with ex vivo nasal model and in vivo rodent tests including disrupted-EV and free-label controls.
